title: Authentication
loginFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
unauthenticated: You are not authenticated. No user identity is available.
identityError: Unable to load your identity. Please try refreshing the page.
localDevIdentity: This is a fixed local development identity. Sign-out is not available.
developmentUnavailable: Development-only options are unavailable unless the server confirms a development environment.
secretRequired: A new client secret is required for every OIDC revision. Stored secrets cannot be viewed or copied.
allowHTTP: Allow HTTP callbacks on loopback in development
localHelp: Local DEV is development-only and must never be enabled in production. Saving this draft does not switch the running provider.
managementOnly: Management only: drafts and approvals do not change running authentication.
offlineHelp: Validation checks settings offline. It does not contact the provider or confirm that SSO login works.
creator: Created by
approveHelp: Approval records an administrative decision only. Offline validation does not test login, and approval does not activate this configuration.
validationSaved: Offline validation completed. Login has not been tested.
approvalSaved: Revision approved. Running authentication is unchanged.
revisionConflict: The configuration changed. Current metadata has been refreshed. Review it before submitting again.
settingsUnavailable: Authentication configuration is unavailable. Please try again later.
futureCapabilities: Activation and rollback are planned for Phase 9.2.5.
testHelp: Opens an isolated OIDC login for this approved revision. Success verifies only the tested identity, creates no application session, and does not activate or change the provider. The test expires after five minutes.
testIdentity: Verified test identity (not an application login)
testPopupBlocked: Allow popups to start the connection test.
testUnavailable: The connection test could not be completed or its result retrieved. Review the configuration and try again.
test_succeeded: Connection test succeeded. The running provider is unchanged.
test_failed: Connection test failed. No provider was activated.
test_expired: Connection test expired. Start a new test.
enrollmentHelp: Enrollment grants the selected application role. It does not activate authentication or link identities by email. Existing roles are preserved.
enrollmentConflict: Evidence is expired, already used, or out of date. Run a new connection test.
enrollmentFailed: Could not enroll the identity. Check your permissions and service availability.
setupSummary: Copy these trusted application values into your identity provider.
setupProviderHelp_okta: Create an OIDC Web Application in Okta and use the issuer for the intended authorization server.
setupProviderHelp_auth0: Create a Regular Web Application in Auth0 and use the exact tenant or custom-domain issuer.
setupProviderHelp_entra: Create a Web application registration in Microsoft Entra ID and use its exact OpenID Connect issuer.
setupProviderHelp_google: Create an OAuth 2.0 Web application client in Google and use the Google OpenID Connect issuer.
setupProviderHelp_generic: Use a standards-compatible OIDC provider that supports discovery, Authorization Code flow, PKCE S256, and client_secret_basic.
setupSharedEngine: All templates use the same verified OIDC engine; the template changes guidance only.
setupClientAuthenticationHelp: The provider must accept the client ID and secret through HTTP Basic authentication (client_secret_basic).
setupDevelopmentHTTP: Development callback: HTTP is permitted only for this trusted loopback development origin. Production callbacks must use HTTPS.
setupHTTPSCallbacks: These trusted callback URLs use HTTPS. Production deployments require HTTPS.
setupDraftHelp: After configuring the provider, enter its exact issuer URL, client ID, and new client secret below. The trusted normal callback URL is supplied automatically as the redirect URI.
setupTrustedRedirect: Supplied by trusted server configuration and cannot be edited here.
setupUnavailable: OIDC provider setup metadata is unavailable. Existing authentication settings remain available.
activationFirstCutoverWarning: This first cutover ends Local DEV or environment authentication immediately. Existing sessions will not carry over.
activationTransitionWarning: Previously verified database OIDC sessions may drain only for the selected bounded transition period.
activationRecoveryRunbook: Consult the deployment operator runbook. This acknowledgement does not prove that recovery works.
activationAcknowledgeReauthentication: I understand that existing Local DEV authentication will stop working immediately after activation.
activationAcknowledgeRecovery: I acknowledge the risk of administrator lockout and confirm that the emergency recovery procedure has been reviewed.
activationPreparationExpired: The activation preparation or its evidence has expired. Start a new preparation.
activationOutcome_committed_applied: Authentication activation committed and applied successfully.
activationOutcome_committed_not_applied: Authentication activation was committed to PostgreSQL, but this instance has not yet applied the configuration.
activationOutcome_commit_uncertain: Database commit outcome is uncertain. Do not retry activation until authoritative state has been inspected.
activationOutcome_not_committed: Authentication activation was not committed. Review the rejection and start a fresh preparation when appropriate.
activationOutcome_outcome_unknown: Outcome unknown. The activation response was lost; inspect authoritative state before taking another action.
activationNoRetry: Never resubmit activation for this outcome. Inspect or reconcile the committed generation.
activationReauthenticateGuidance: If this was the first cutover, authenticate again with the newly active OIDC provider. Local DEV must not be restored.
activationAffinityUnavailable: Authentication activation preparation is unavailable until the deployment is configured for a single instance or reliable session affinity.
activationEmergencyRecoveryRequired: Review the emergency recovery procedure before this first cutover. Local DEV will not remain as a fallback.
activationEnrollmentMissing: No active enrolled OIDC administrator with admin.manage was found for the verified identity.
activationNormalTestPending: Waiting for the normal callback test to complete…
activationBlocked_affinity: Activation preparation is disabled because deployment affinity is not configured.
activationBlocked_wrong_instance: This workflow reached another application instance. Keep the entire workflow on the originating instance and start a fresh preparation.
activationBlocked_provider_unavailable: The recovery provider is unavailable. Portal recovery cannot continue; follow the approved offline recovery procedure.
activationBlocked_popup_closed: The verification window closed before readiness was confirmed. Start a fresh preparation.
activationBlocked_readiness_failed: Normal callback readiness could not be verified. Start a fresh preparation.
activationSubmitting: Submitting activation once. Do not refresh or retry…
recoveryDraftExplanation: This creates a new immutable draft from the historical revision. It does not change running authentication or reactivate history.
recoveryFreshEvidenceRequired: The new draft still requires validation, approval, and fresh isolated and normal-callback evidence before activation.
recoveryDraftCreated: Recovery draft created. Running authentication is unchanged.
recoveryDraftFailed: The recovery draft could not be created.
recoveryEvidenceReadiness: Configuration: {{configuration}}; administrator: {{administrator}}; isolated evidence: {{isolated}}; normal evidence: {{normal}}.
recoveryNotLiveHealth: This reports configuration and evidence readiness; it is not a live identity-provider health check.
recoveryReadinessUnavailable: Recovery readiness is unavailable or this is not a recovery revision.
activationIsolatedExpiredBlocker: Isolated evidence has expired. Run the isolated test again.
activationIsolatedMissingBlocker: A successful isolated connection test is required.
activationEnrollmentBlocker: The verified identity must be an active enrolled administrator with admin.manage.
activationNormalExpiredBlocker: Normal callback evidence has expired. Start a new preparation and repeat the callback test.
activationNormalMissingBlocker: A successful normal callback test is required.
activationCancelFailed: The preparation could not be released. Check its status before trying again.
activationBlocked_preparation_conflict: Another preparation is still active. Discard it before starting a new one.
verificationPopupReturn: Return to the administrator window to check the verified result. This page does not enable authentication.
testWillApprove: Testing will validate and approve this revision before secure sign-in. It will not enable authentication.
recoveryReadinessNotApplicable: No recovery readiness information is available for this revision.
accessDomainsHelp: Additional restriction: enter exact domains separated by commas. An empty list allows any domain. Restricted domains require verified email.
accessIdentitiesHelp: Select an existing OIDC user by issuer and subject. Email invitations for identities with an unknown subject will be available separately.
accessSelfLoss: I understand that my current OIDC identity will lose application access.
accessPreviewHelp: This preview uses stored verified identity information. The server rechecks authorization and current state when saving.
accessLastAdmin: At least one approved, active OIDC administrator must remain eligible.
accessConflict: The records changed. Refresh and review the latest values; cancel your edits before starting again.
accessUnavailable: User access management is unavailable. Refresh or contact the deployment operator.
accessInvalid: Check the domains, default role, generations and change reason.
accessSetupHelp: The access policy has not been initialized. Ask the deployment operator to follow docs/oidc-access-policy.md and the secure bootstrap procedure. This page cannot bootstrap an administrator.
accessUncertain: The write outcome is unknown. Do not repeat the change. Inspect current policy and audit records with the deployment operator before continuing.
accessProviderHelp: Current provider identifies the configured issuer; it is not a live identity-provider health check.
accessApproveHelp: Approve this exact issuer and subject for login. Roles and user activation remain unchanged.
accessRevokeHelp: Revoke login approval and end existing application sessions for this identity.
accessReasonHelp: 8–512 characters; control characters are not allowed.
